 -versus-

Opposite Parties
 Mr. Aurobinda Mohanty,
 Addl. Standing Counsel
 Coram:
THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.K. SAHOO THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE CHITTARANJAN DASH Order No. ORDER 06.11.2024 02.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This writ petition has been filed by the petitioner Arun Kumar Behera with a prayer to quash the order dated 06.07.2024 passed by the Collector, Balasore (opposite party no.2) under Annexure-1 with a further prayer to direct the opposite parties to award compensation in respect of Khata No.316/578 pertaining to Plot No.706/1697/2217 in the mouza Khunta and Khata No.316/530 pertaining to Plot No.706/1697/2149 in the mouza Khunta in view of the provision laid down in Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Re-settlement Act, 2013, treating the said plot of the petitioner as homestead land and provide adequate compensation.
Referring to the notification dated 24.12.2020, the learned counsel for the petitioner urged that Sl.
No.3 of the said notification would indicate that the two plots of the petitioner, which are plot nos.706/1648 & 706/1728 of khata no.316/82 were acquired on 24.12.2020 and by that time, one house was in existence, but the authority has not paid any compensation for the house and vide impugned order dated 06.07.2024, the opposite party no.2 has observed that since the petitioner has received the compensation amount as regard to the trees along with the land compensation and the house was not in existence when the notification dated 20.02.2016 was published and it was a subsequent construction after the issuance of 11(1) notification, therefore, he is not entitled to get any compensation.
According to the learned counsel, such observation of the opposite party no.2 is completely erroneous.
